messages:
sam_ops: Vendor just flagged a customs reclassification in FRA. Proposed split: rush 6 H200 by air, remainder H100 by sea + 4 H200 cold-chain by sea. Need quick call on air surcharge vs customer impact.

amy_vendor: Correct. Air for 6 H200 available at +$1.6k/unit (includes expedited clearance). Sea adds ~10 days. Insurance option: vendor 40% / customer 60% or we absorb air surcharge and vendor covers freight.

claire_prod: ap-southeast edge is low on spares; eu-west has degraded NVLink on r5 racks. If we air the H200s they must go to eu-west first to restore capacity.

oli_infra: Confirmed NVLink fault on r5. Depot cross-dock can accept 12 crates Wed morning. We should stage replacing r5 then other critical racks. Also request packing spec for H200 bracing.

julie_finance: Budget check: +9.6k surcharge total if we air 6 H200. We can cover as emergency but need PO amendment and invoice line for duty prepay if vendor advances it. We prefer vendor take 40% insurance only if they provide preprinted RMA labels and photo evidence clause.

sam_ops: amy_vendor 7 can you confirm AWB will contain original serial numbers (not temp IDs)? Last time depot rejected DOA returns due to mismatched serials. Also request 5-day RMA booking SLA for air DOAs and 14-day SLA for sea.

amy_vendor: We'll add original serials on AWB and crate labels. Preprinted RMA labels and a photo checklist will be included. 5-day booking SLA for air OK; sea 14 days. AWB preview: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/KJ4421.

oli_infra: Please include crate foam spec and cushion rating on the packing list for H200 units. Depot confirmed thermal handling capacity and power testing on receipt.

claire_prod: Recommend: air 6 H200 to eu-west (prioritize r5), sea ship H100 bulk + remaining H200 for APAC. Accept vendor 40% / us 60% insurance if RMA labels + photo checklist included and vendor prepays part of duties when requested. Ops to open surge budget ticket.

julie_finance: ack if vendor adds the photo-evidence clause and we get duty prepay invoice line. I'll start PO amendment.

sam_ops: opening OPS ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4672. Scheduling maintenance windows: r5 canary replace Fri 02:00-03:30 UTC, follow-up block Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC.

amy_vendor: ack 7 updating manifest and will send the customs clearance receipt + final AWB once PO amend done. We'll mark air AWB KJ4421-01 and include RMA labels in crates.

logistics-bot: Carrier ETA Wed 06:00 UTC (air), sea ETA +10d. Manifest uploaded: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/KJ4421.

sam_ops: please reply with "ack" when tasks done so we can close thread.

julie_finance: ack 7 initiating PO amend.

oli_infra: ack 7 posting maintenance windows to #eng-infra.

amy_vendor: ack 7 will post AWB + customs docs here when live.
